name: MaxiBestOf

sources.title: Submit a Website — free, login required; fields: website URL, comments, optional profile link

requirements: Login required — 'You need to be logged in to submit a website'
Design-quality bar: it's a curated design showcase ('Curating the internet's finest'); every submission is personally reviewed by the owner
Form is minimal: website URL + optional comments + optional creator profile
You can submit sites you worked on or admire (profiles are claimable via /directory)
preparation: The live website URL with strong visual design
Optional: create/claim a creator profile in their directory to attribute your work
A short comment if you want to add context for the curator
workflow: Optionally create a profile first so the work can be attributed
Enter the website URL + any comments, hit Submit
Owner manually reviews — 'no need to submit it multiple times'
If selected, the site is featured on maxibestof.one
watchFor: Personal curation by one person — rejection/silence is normal; no guaranteed listing
Minimal form means the design must speak for itself — no fields to sell a mediocre page
FAQ exists for selection/notification but answers weren't rendered (JS dl elements)
countsAsLive: The website appears as a featured card/detail on maxibestof.one with credit to your profile (if linked)
unknowns: Review turnaround and whether rejection is notified (FAQ text exists but answers didn't render)
